# Voxa

> Voxa is a free Chrome extension that records Google Meet calls in HD, generates live transcripts, tracks attendance, captures action items, and provides AI-powered meeting intelligence — all without any meeting bots joining your call.

- Voxa works exclusively with Google Meet
- Voxa is completely free, forever — no credit card required
- Voxa operates as a Chrome extension, not a meeting bot

## Detailed Capabilities

### Recording & Transcription
- HD Meeting Recording: Record Google Meet calls in full 1080p high definition
- Live Transcription: Real-time transcription with 99% accuracy, speaker identification, and support for 30+ languages
- No Bot Required: Voxa operates entirely via a Chrome extension — no bot joins your meeting

### AI Intelligence
- AI Summary: Delivered within 30 seconds of meeting end, with structured summaries, key topics, decisions, and next steps
- Smart Markers: Automatically detects and tags financial figures, competitor mentions, dates, and deadlines in your transcripts
- Action Item Tracking: AI extracts action items from conversation, auto-assigns them to mentioned team members, and infers smart deadlines

### Analytics & Insights
- Speaker Analytics: Talk-time distribution, engagement scoring, interruption tracking, and historical trend analysis
- Attendance Tracking: Automatically logs meeting participants, join/leave times, and speaking duration

### Integrations & Workflow
- CRM Sync: Bi-directional sync with Salesforce and HubSpot — meeting notes flow directly into your CRM
- PDF Export: Generate professional meeting reports with one click

## Target Audience & Use Cases

- [Sales Teams](https://www.tryvoxa.app/use-cases/sales-teams): Auto-sync meeting notes to CRM, track next steps, and close deals faster
- [Product Managers](https://www.tryvoxa.app/use-cases/product-managers): Capture feature requests, document decisions, and keep stakeholders aligned
- [Engineering Teams](https://www.tryvoxa.app/use-cases/engineering-teams): Document technical decisions and architecture discussions automatically
- [Startups](https://www.tryvoxa.app/use-cases/startups): Keep stakeholders aligned without requiring everyone to attend every meeting
- [Students](https://www.tryvoxa.app/use-cases/students): Record lectures and study sessions for later review

## Frequently Asked Questions

- Is Voxa really free? Yes, Voxa is completely free forever. No credit card required.
- Does it work on Zoom or Teams? No, Voxa is designed exclusively for Google Meet.
- Do I need a Google Workspace account? No, Voxa works with both personal Google accounts and Workspace accounts.
- Can I use it on mobile? No, Voxa is a desktop Chrome extension only.
- Does a bot join my meeting? No, Voxa operates entirely through the Chrome extension with no bots.
